1: // Simple Meteor Shield game
2: // Canvas element with id="game"
3: (() => {
4:   const canvas = document.getElementById('game');
5:   if (!canvas) return;
6:   const ctx = canvas.getContext('2d');
7:   // size canvas to its displayed size
8:   canvas.width = canvas.clientWidth;
9:   canvas.height = canvas.clientHeight;
10: 
11:   const shield = { width: 80, height: 10, x: canvas.width / 2 - 40, y: canvas.height - 20 };
12:   const meteors = [];
13:   let health = 5;
14:   let lastSpawn = 0;
15:   const spawnInterval = 1000; // ms
16: 
17:   // input handling
18:   const moveShield = (dx) => {
19:     shield.x = Math.max(0, Math.min(canvas.width - shield.width, shield.x + dx));
20:   };
21:   window.addEventListener('mousemove', (e) => {
22:     const rect = canvas.getBoundingClientRect();
23:     const mouseX = e.clientX - rect.left;
24:     shield.x = Math.max(0, Math.min(canvas.width - shield.width, mouseX - shield.width / 2));
25:   });
26:   window.addEventListener('keydown', (e) => {
27:     if (e.key === 'ArrowLeft') moveShield(-10);
28:     if (e.key === 'ArrowRight') moveShield(10);
29:   });
30: 
31:   const spawnMeteor = () => {
32:     const radius = 10 + Math.random() * 10;
33:     const x = Math.random() * (canvas.width - radius * 2) + radius;
34:     const speed = 2 + Math.random() * 3;
35:     meteors.push({ x, y: -radius, radius, speed });
36:   };
37: 
38:   const update = (dt) => {
39:     // spawn
40:     if (performance.now() - lastSpawn > spawnInterval) {
41:       spawnMeteor();
42:       lastSpawn = performance.now();
43:     }
44:     // move meteors
45:     for (let i = meteors.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
46:       const m = meteors[i];
47:       m.y += m.speed;
48:       // collision with shield
49:       if (
50:         m.y + m.radius >= shield.y &&
51:         m.x > shield.x &&
52:         m.x < shield.x + shield.width
53:       ) {
54:         meteors.splice(i, 1);
55:         continue;
56:       }
57:       // missed
58:       if (m.y - m.radius > canvas.height) {
59:         meteors.splice(i, 1);
60:         health--;
61:         if (health <= 0) {
62:           // game over, stop animation
63:           alert('Game Over');
64:           window.location.reload();
65:         }
66:       }
67:     }
68:   };
69: 
70:   const draw = () => {
71:     ctx.clearRect(0, 0, canvas.width, canvas.height);
72:     // shield
73:     ctx.fillStyle = 'blue';
74:     ctx.fillRect(shield.x, shield.y, shield.width, shield.height);
75:     // meteors
76:     ctx.fillStyle = 'gray';
77:     meteors.forEach(m => {
78:       ctx.beginPath();
79:       ctx.arc(m.x, m.y, m.radius, 0, Math.PI * 2);
80:       ctx.fill();
81:     });
82:     // health
83:     ctx.fillStyle = 'black';
84:     ctx.font = '16px sans-serif';
85:     ctx.fillText('Health: ' + health, 10, 20);
86:   };
87: 
88:   let lastTime = performance.now();
89:   const loop = () => {
90:     const now = performance.now();
91:     const dt = now - lastTime;
92:     lastTime = now;
93:     update(dt);
94:     draw();
95:     requestAnimationFrame(loop);
96:   };
97:   requestAnimationFrame(loop);
98: })();
